title: Home Mortgage Loans: underwriting entry thresholds by program
content:
# Home Mortgage Loans: underwriting entry thresholds by program

This document sets out, for each Home Mortgage Loans program, the loan-amount range, the largest loan-to-value ratio (LTV), the lowest representative credit score and the highest debt-to-income ratio (DTI) that underwriting accepts, together with the entry conditions each program imposes.

## Thresholds by program

| Program | Smallest loan amount (USD) | Largest loan amount (USD) | Largest LTV (%) | Lowest credit score | Highest DTI (%) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| FHA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 50000.00 | 524225.00 | 96.5 | 580 | 57 |
| VA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 50000.00 | 1500000.00 | 100 | 580 | 60 |
| Conventional 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 50000.00 | 832750.00 | 97 | 620 | 50 |
| Conventional 15-Year Fixed Mortgage | 50000.00 | 832750.00 | 97 | 620 | 50 |
| 7/6 SOFR Adjustable-Rate Mortgage | 100000.00 | 1500000.00 | 95 | 660 | 45 |
| Jumbo 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 832751.00 | 3000000.00 | 80 | 700 | 43 |

The largest LTV is the largest loan amount expressed as a percent of the lower of the appraised value and the purchase price. The credit score is the borrower's representative credit score, and the DTI is the borrower's debt-to-income ratio.

## Entry conditions of every program

A loan enters a program only when every condition in that program's row holds:

- the LTV is at most the program's largest LTV;
- the representative credit score is at least the program's lowest credit score;
- the DTI is at most the program's highest DTI;
- the occupancy type is one of the program's eligible occupancy types.

Two programs add a further entry condition:

| Program | Additional entry condition |
|---|---|
| VA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | The borrower holds a VA certificate of eligibility. |
| Jumbo 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | The loan amount is at least the program's smallest loan amount of 832751.00. |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical inputs)

| Program | Hypothetical input | Result against the threshold |
|---|---|---|
| FHA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | LTV of exactly 96.5 | Meets "at most 96.5" |
| FHA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | LTV of 96.51 | Above the largest LTV |
| Conventional 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | Credit score of exactly 620 | Meets "at least 620" |
| Conventional 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | Credit score of 619 | Below the lowest credit score |
| 7/6 SOFR Adjustable-Rate Mortgage | DTI of exactly 45 | Meets "at most 45" |
| Jumbo 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | Loan amount of 832750.00 | Below the Jumbo smallest loan amount |

## Points of judgement

- The Conventional programs' largest loan amount (832750.00) and the Jumbo program's smallest loan amount (832751.00) are one dollar apart, so a loan amount of 832750.00 lies inside the Conventional range and below the Jumbo range.
- The VA certificate of eligibility is an entry condition of the VA program only; the table lists it for no other program.
